scope: Netherlands medical discovery — Radboud University Medical Center

verifiedFacts.claim: Radboud University Medical Center reports that NVAO renewed full accreditation of its Bachelor and Master in Medicine programmes for the next six years.
NVAO's official decision page records a positive 2025 institutional audit for Radboud University Nijmegen.
Radboud University explains that programme accreditation and institutional quality assurance are overseen by NVAO.

holdReasons: No current official Bachelor of Medicine structure, tuition amount, language-of-instruction, admissions requirements or international route was established.
The accreditation evidence is strong but a complete current programme curriculum, clinical placement and graduate-practice evidence packet was not completed.
A complete accommodation and international student-support packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain Radboud's current Medicine admissions and programme information, including Dutch-language/numerus-fixus conditions, fees and clinical/student-support evidence before packaging.
